summary: Build patient flow, staffing, and quality control skills in 5 days. Enroll in hospital and clinic operations management training today.
lede: Healthcare operations management coordinates the people, information, and resources that support patient care. For hospital and clinic professionals responsible for service performance, it involves mapping patient journeys, analyzing throughput and capacity, and planning staffing. The course also covers using EHR data and operational measures to identify bottlenecks and prepare quality reports and service improvement plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for healthcare professionals who manage operational performance, patient flow, service capacity, and quality reporting in hospitals and clinics.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working experience in hospital, clinic, or healthcare administration environments; familiarity with basic healthcare operations terms; and comfort reading operational reports, staffing rosters, and KPI dashboards. You do not need coding skills, but you should be prepared to work with Excel-based analysis, process maps, audit checklists, and quality metrics. Participants at advanced level will benefit most if they already manage departmental workflows, quality reporting, patient access, or resource planning.
